name: MCP server
description: `afterglow mcp`: a Model Context Protocol server over stdio that serves every app's command catalog as tools. MCPVersions pins the protocol revisions (2026-07-28 sessionless; 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 start with initialize); JSONRPC frames one JSON-RPC 2.0 message per line; MCPServer (with MCPOptions: apps, roots, limits) answers each line; MCPTools lists the tools and routes a tool name to an MCPRoute; MCPSessions holds the open documents by expiring handle and returns MCPToolResults. MC-4 builds the server: strict JSON-RPC parsing (-32700, -32600), version negotiation (-32602 listing supportedVersions), server/discover, initialize, ping, tools/list, rate-limited tools/call, silent notifications, and serve (`--app`, `--root`, `--live`) reading stdin line by line; MC-6 and MC-8 fill the tools and the calls.
